name: Bud & Ritas - West Town
website: https://budandritas.com/stores/west-town-dispensary-chicago/ (brand site https://budandritas.com ; the brand is 'Bud & Rita's' with an apostrophe, registry spells it 'Bud & Ritas')
menu_url: https://budandritas.com/menu/ (shared across the chain; branch chosen by the store-select cookie/geolocation) - the branch-pinned page that exposes the store id is https://budandritas.com/stores/west-town-dispensary-chicago/. Recreational menu only (MEDICAL search returns 0).
how_menu_reached: WordPress site with the Joint Commerce 'joint-ecommerce' plugin (v1.46.1) rendering the menu client-side on /menu/ (also on /stores/<slug>/ branch pages). Footer tag mentions dutchieplus (a CNNA tag manager), but the menu is not Dutchie: the product API is the plugin's own wp-json search. Chain has 7 IL stores: West Town, Avondale, The Loop, Niles, Wadsworth, Forsyth, Sycamore (coming soon).
branch_selection: Joint business id. The branch page embeds `jointEcommerce.currentStore = {joint_business_id: 6359, display_name: "Bud & Rita's: West Town", name: "Bud & Rita's West Town", address_1: '1914 W Chicago Ave', city: 'Chicago'}` (exactly what backend/providers/joint.py joint_store() reads). The chain's business ids seen in stores/closest: 6359 (West Town), 6366, 6374, 6407, 6411, 6451. The generic /menu/ and home pages carry no currentStore, so they cannot be pinned to a branch.
age_gate: click-through (WordPress age-gate plugin, GET /wp-json/age-gate/v3/check; auto-click works)

data_loading.mechanism: REST POST to an Elasticsearch-style search under the WordPress plugin namespace (no auth, no nonce needed for the search itself)
data_loading.notes: The POST URL is already supported by backend/network.py _JOINT_SEARCH_POST and providers/joint.py (native). Each hit has variants[] (option, price, specialPrice, quantity, menuType, jointId), category (FLOWER, PRE_ROLLS, VAPORIZERS, CONCENTRATES, EDIBLES, TOPICALS, ORAL, MERCH, NONE), brandName, potencies, applicableSpecials. Note providers/joint.py CATEGORIES only maps FLOWER/CONCENTRATES/VAPORIZERS, so PRE_ROLLS (187 products here) are categorized 'other'.

paging: from/size with size 100 (WINDOW 10000). hits.total = {value 948, relation eq}; 10 pages (9x100 + 48). Replaying the pipeline's own filter and sort gave 948 unique = 948 declared, 948 RECREATIONAL variants (one variant per product here). Without the jointId tiebreaker the pages are unstable (the page's own query returned 920 unique of 948), which providers/joint.py already handles.
license_channels: recreational-only in practice: MEDICAL menuType search returned 0 for businessId 6359

why_it_fails: Pure discovery failure; the platform adapter is complete. (1) locators.CONNECTORS has no entry for the brand, so the chain-hub stage returns 'No retailer locator connector configured'. (2) The fallback search (site_discovery.search_websites by name, then by address) came back empty in 0.6 s - the brief's known dead search backend (DuckDuckGo 202 challenge / Bing unrelated), and the registry name 'Bud & Ritas' (no apostrophe) does not help a name query. Once budandritas.com/stores/west-town-dispensary-chicago/ is fetched, adapters.resolve_menu already detects 'jointEcommerce' and providers/joint.observe() yields provider joint, provider_store_id 6359, with retailer_address 1914 W Chicago Ave, and providers/joint.fetch would reconcile 948 = 948 (grade A candidate).
fix_idea: Add a CONNECTORS entry such as (r"^bud\s*(?:&|and)?\s*rita", 'https://budandritas.com/stores/') so the hub's city-token link matcher yields the three Chicago branch pages (west-town / avondale / the-loop) and joint.observe() disambiguates by currentStore.address_1. More generally, a Joint-platform hub locator: any WordPress site with joint-ecommerce exposes /stores/<slug>/ pages with currentStore ids; walk them and match street address. Normalize registry names by stripping '&' and apostrophes before name matching ('Bud & Ritas' vs "Bud & Rita's"). Optional: map PRE_ROLLS in providers/joint.CATEGORIES so pre-roll $/g offers are comparable.
